description: An original cute feminine little botanical apprentice character voice. Light warm soprano, bright rounded vowels and a smiling gentle lilt. Playful curiosity, softly buoyant phrasing, tender encouraging warmth. Small delighted inflections with clear relaxed speech. No shouting, no whispering, no singing.
text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
